note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: Google alters its cloud playbook, enlisting partners to sell more AI chips
items.blurb: Oracle will offer Google's TPU chips to its customers, widening Google's challenge to Nvidia beyond its own cloud.

items.title: Anthropic IPO filing warns some risks may be uninsurable. AI coverage will be issue for every company
items.blurb: Anthropic's prospectus says some AI risks may be impossible to insure, raising coverage questions for every AI adopter.

items.title: Alphabet sinks 10% as it holds 2026 capex unchanged, expects significant increase in 2027
items.blurb: Alphabet missed estimates and signaled a large 2027 spending jump, while its Gemini app reached 1 billion users.

items.title: Nvidia's $12.9 billion Hugging Face deal draws DOJ scrutiny
items.blurb: The Justice Department is asking how Nvidia owning the main open-model hub could affect rival chipmakers and developers.

items.title: Microsoft stock jumps 4% as cloud growth drives earnings and revenue beat
items.blurb: Strong Azure growth and rising Copilot use lifted Microsoft, a contrast with Alphabet's earnings reception the same day.

items.title: Inside "Black October": AI's cyber scare delivers a Y2K lesson
items.blurb: The feared wave of attacks after AI-found flaws in PHP and Brotli has largely not arrived, researchers say.

items.title: Bond investors have gotten picky about AI
items.blurb: Lenders now judge AI borrowers one by one, after CoreWeave yields spiked and Oracle-linked data center debt drew scrutiny.

items.title: US productivity gains may have less to do with AI
items.blurb: Productivity is rising, but the evidence that AI is the driver is mixed and gains cluster at the companies building it.

items.title: Strong GDP reading likely due to consumer spending, AI buildout
items.blurb: AI capital spending lifts third-quarter growth, though imported chips mean the boost is smaller than headline spending suggests.

items.title: CNBC Technology Summit 2026: Navigating enterprise AI adoption
items.blurb: Executives weighed agent adoption and accuracy; one study found 40% of AI outputs contained at least one major error.

items.title: Nvidia, AMD to invest $4 billion in Meta as tech giants deepen AI partnership
items.blurb: Nvidia will put $3 billion and AMD $1 billion into Meta's $95 billion offering to fund AI infrastructure.

items.title: Anthropic IPO leads AI's $235 billion dealmaking blitz
items.blurb: Anthropic's filing, which may seek a record $100 billion, capped a day of giant AI financing deals.

items.title: Silicon Valley AI political groups turn on each other in the 2026 election
items.blurb: Pro-acceleration and pro-safeguard AI groups have spent about $15 million combined on congressional races before Nov 3.

items.title: Anthropic's IPO is risky business
items.blurb: A look at the unusual risk disclosures in Anthropic's S-1, from model safety incidents to political exposure.

items.title: Oracle integrates ChatGPT, Codex into apps and expands cloud chip lineup
items.blurb: Oracle will rent out Google's TPUs and OpenAI's own chip, widening alternatives to Nvidia hardware for AI customers.

items.title: Amazon's anti-tokenmaxxing memo says engineers should be pickier about using AI
items.blurb: Amazon calls token counts and code volume weak gauges of AI use, favoring shipped features as its yardstick.

items.title: SpaceX closes $40 billion debt deal for AI chips, Elon Musk says
items.blurb: SpaceX lined up $40 billion in debt for GPUs due in early 2027, as credit tightens for smaller AI cloud firms.

items.title: A shock in Brazil sends stocks plunging, while neoclouds take another hit
items.blurb: Shares of neoclouds, the GPU-rental firms behind much AI compute, fell again as investors question how the buildout is financed.

items.title: Anthropic IPO live updates: AI lab lost $80.7 billion in first half of 2026
items.blurb: Anthropic filed to list on Nasdaq as ANT, showing $16.29 billion in first-half revenue against heavy losses and compute commitments.

items.title: Meta launches plan for $95 billion stock offering to fund AI expansion
items.blurb: Meta will sell $35 billion in stock now and $60 billion over time to fund four gigawatt-scale AI superclusters.

items.title: Cracking AI trade has Wall Street looking for a hedge. An ex-Citadel quant may have the answer
items.blurb: Startup Hyperbolic is building a tradable market for GPU computing power, letting investors hedge against falling AI demand.

items.title: Investors are doing just as well this year by shunning AI. How to invest if the tech trade keeps fizzling
items.blurb: A Goldman index excluding AI stocks briefly outpaced the S&P 500 as tech fell about 7% in October.

items.title: Claude says Anthropic's IPO is a buy. ChatGPT disagrees
items.blurb: Axios had rival chatbots read Anthropic's filing, which shows a $974 million second-quarter operating profit.

items.title: Scoop: The FTC is demanding Anthropic execs testify in expanding AI safety probe
items.blurb: The FTC's consumer-harm probe now reaches Anthropic's leadership on the day the company's IPO filing went public.
